title: 23 Mexico 2544: Mexico: Weekly Political Blotter, September 11-15
doc_notes: This document is a weekly political blotter from the U.S. Embassy in Mexico, which includes a brief summary of a Mexican Congressional hearing regarding UAP and alleged alien remains.

incidents.summary: Mexican pilots' encounters with fast-moving flying objects during flight presented to Congress.
